description: Call this when someone says they were laid off from a company or asks whether a company or state has layoffs. Layoff notices (WARN Act filings) collected from U.S. state labor departments, newest first. Filter by employer, state and days back. Use it to answer "is [company] laying people off?" or "which employers filed layoff notices in [state]?". Each notice has the employer, place, workers named, filing date, the state record and a NextChapter page to link to. A notice states the number of workers and dates the employer reported; it does not say why. Free to cite under CC BY 4.0 with a link back.

days.description: How many days back to look (1 to 365, default 30).

employer.description: Employer name or part of it, e.g. "Comcast".

limit.description: Most notices to return (1 to 100, default 10).

name: recent_layoff_notices
title: Recent layoff notices
